name: Schroeder Furniture & Flooring
old_description: Schroeder Furniture & Flooring is an independently owned and operated business since 1947. Visit our conveniently located showroom to see many varieties and styles of furniture, flooring, and much more.
about:
Schroeder Furniture & Flooring has served Langdon, North Dakota since 1947 as an independently owned and operated business. Founded in the post-war era, the company has remained under independent ownership for over seven decades. It operates a showroom on Highway 5 West where it displays a broad selection of home furnishings and building materials.

The showroom stocks furniture, flooring, tile, mattresses, lighting, window treatments, home accents, décor, and paint. Beyond retail, the company provides professional installation services for hardwood, vinyl tile, and carpet flooring using licensed and insured installers. Free delivery within a 70-mile radius is available for furniture, mattresses, and other large purchases, a service highlighted as a customer convenience.

The business primarily serves residential customers across Langdon and the surrounding region, supporting homeowners engaged in renovation, new construction, or furnishing projects. Schroeder is a member of the National Federation of Independent Business, reflecting its small-business orientation and commitment to independent enterprise.

The company emphasizes a hands-on showroom experience, promoting style, selection, and satisfaction as core values. Its decades-long presence in the community underscores a focus on personal customer relationships and local service, with the team positioning itself as the area's local flooring experts.
